story.sub: It began with a simple meeting
story.p1: Meet Lounge began with a simple meeting: two friends, one table, one cup of coffee. Our logo says the same thing: two rings of steam that overlap and make a shared place.
story.p2: Every morning we bake the pastries on site, grind the coffee fresh, and take a little more care than we need to so your cup arrives just right.
